# KDLM

> > Award-winning New York personal injury and medical malpractice law firm specializing in landmark verdicts and high-value settlements for victims of negligence.

KDLM (Kramer Dillof Livingston & Moore) is a top-tier personal injury law firm based in New York with expertise in medical malpractice, wrongful death, construction accidents, and birth injuries. The firm is known for securing landmark verdicts and million-dollar settlements on a no-fee contingency basis.

- Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
- Meningitis Claims
- New York City & Staten Island
